CREATE TABLE `whatsapp_messages_log` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `phone_number` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `direction` enum('incoming','outgoing') NOT NULL,
  `message_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `message_content` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `empresa_id` int(11) DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_phone_created` (`phone_number`,`created_at`),
  KEY `fk_empresa_whatsapp_messages_log` (`empresa_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_empresa_whatsapp_messages_log` FOREIGN KEY (`empresa_id`) REFERENCES `empresas` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
